research_rationale: The full held official FR extract contains ten substantive units across sections 1-4; the section 2 lead-in is merged into section 2(a), not treated as an independent command. Sections 1-3 establish, staff, direct and support the President's Council on Aging without an express sunset. EO 11376 replaces the original section 1(b), subject to its outstanding page check; EO 12106 section 1-103 replaces that membership again, expressly effective January 1, 1979 under section 1-106. EO 12379 section 12 revokes EO 11022 as amended in full; section 12 is the actor's locator, not a partial target restriction. Its complete two-page extract contains no separate delayed effective-date or savings provision, so the formal revocation event is dated August 17, 1982, but its cleanup preamble cannot prove first cessation. Spurious claim-kit chain entries reuse that same 1982 text under other actor IDs and earlier signing dates and are rejected. Section 4's already-executed abolition and supersession need separate lifecycle and residual analysis. This is a partial producer candidate retaining the provisional no status, with no whole-order first-end finding and no search/exhaustion claim.
unresolved_material_gaps: ORIGINAL_IMAGE_NOT_HELD: full official EO 11022 extract is held and matches the source record whose PDF hash matches GPO PREMIS, but the cited PDF/page bytes were not found locally and were not visually inspected. No image-read claim is made.

EARLIER_PARTIAL_END: EO 11376 substitutes section 1(b), so 1982 cannot be the first end of the original membership text. Its official extract has medium location confidence, damaged order-number OCR and requires_page_check=true; the required page image is unavailable. Exact first-end evidence remains incomplete.

EARLIER_CESSATION: EO 12379 is a formal cleanup of establishing authorities for inactive or no-longer-necessary committees. No original sunset appears in EO 11022, but the held sources do not establish whether its council-related commands ceased earlier through a legally effective action or completed purpose. Formal revocation is recorded only as a later event; first_end dates remain null.

SECTION4_AND_SAVINGS: section 4 immediately abolished the prior Federal Council and superseded the March 7, 1959 letter. Execution of that change is not automatically an end of the provision or restoration of the prior body in 1982. Its lifecycle classification and any independently accrued or transferred effects remain unresolved.

EO12107_TARGET: OFR gives an amendment lead, while the held section 2-101(b) list has OCR damage and no unambiguous 11022 string. Its general redesignation applies to orders relating to transferred OPM functions; the exact target treatment and interaction with simultaneously effective EO 12106 require page review.

BOUNDED_SEARCH_NOT_ACCEPTED: the matching MACHINE_LATER_SEARCH row was read, but numbered-EO catalog/text searches and current-law mentions do not establish the first cessation of the council or close independent effects. The USC release is current only through 2026-10-09, not the 2026-10-14 cutoff. later_source_search remains empty.
